changelog:
- Edge16 v1.0.0-alpha.1 experimental alpha for TX16S MK2/MK3; maintainer-tested, use carefully
- Adds global top bar setup and compact TX16S status widgets
- Adds battery monitor/guard with LiPo pack library, telemetry voltage matching, confirmation prompts, capacity/voltage alerts, and optional arming block
- Refreshes TX16S color-LCD UX with dashboard, larger touch targets, settings search/filter, state indicators, swipe gestures, and single-tier navigation
- Makes TX16S color-screen interaction feel smoother with LVGL 9.5, asynchronous drawing, font preload, and rendering cleanup
